title: IncrementStat - Game
content:
Member of: Game Script Modifies the specified misc stat by the given amount. Syntax: Function IncrementStat(string asStatName, int aiModAmount = 1) native global Parameters: - asStatName: The name of the MiscStat - aiModAmount: How much to alter the stat by Default: 1 Return Value: None. Examples: ; Increment the "Houses Owned" stat by 1 Game.IncrementStat("Houses Owned")
; Increment the "Standing Stones Found" stat by 3 Game.IncrementStat("Standing Stones Found", 3)

title: IncrementStat - Game
content:
Notes:
IncrementStat can be used to modify any misc stat that the game tracks. However, its main use is to increment stats that only the designers have knowledge of, i.e. that have no clear representation in the codebase. Those stats are listed below and calls to IncrementStat need to be included in any scripts would alter them:
- Animals Killed
- Armor Improved
- Assaults
- Backstabs
